mapper.insert: INSERT INTO practice_sessions (user_id, status, total_exercises) VALUES (#{userId}, #{status}, #{totalExercises})

INSERT INTO practice_session_exercises (session_id, exercise_order, category, practice_item_id, topic, status, score) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{exerciseOrder}, #{category}, #{practiceItemId}, #{topic}, #{status}, #{score})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, status, total_exercises, created_at, completed_at FROM practice_sessions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, status, total_exercises, created_at, completed_at FROM practice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, session_id, exercise_order, category, practice_item_id, topic, status, score, completed_at FROM practice_session_exercises WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY exercise_order
mapper.update: UPDATE practice_session_exercises SET status = 'DONE', score = #{score}, completed_at = now() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND exercise_order = #{exerciseOrder} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM practice_session_exercises WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'PENDING'
